Mobile version has no access to harness view.
Remove Activity view from all desktop/mobile we have better views for follow-up with tasks

I'll investigate the navigation/views setup in the codebase.Now I have the full picture. Applying the changes:Done. Both requests are implemented in the web client (Vite dev server hot-reloaded every file without transform errors).

## 1. Mobile now has access to the Harness view
- `client/src/config/mobile.js` — new **Harness** tile in the “Work” launcher group (icon `fa-bolt`, “Runs, worker health and audit”), plus `harness: 'Harness'` in `MOBILE_ROUTE_TITLES`. The tile opens the existing `harness` app through the standard `$storex.ui.openApp` path, so it works exactly like Task manager / Planning.
- `client/src/router/index.ts` — the harness route no longer forces `hideTopBar`: on a phone it now gets the mobile app bar (title + back arrow) and highlights the **More** tab it was opened from, instead of the Tasks tab.
- `client/src/components/main-menu/WindowsMenuItems.vue` — **Harness** added to the apps/commands grid (this sheet is also used on mobile), replacing the removed Activity entry.

## 2. Activity view removed everywhere (desktop + mobile)
- `config/apps.js` — `activity` removed from the app registry (no `openApp('activity')` target any more).
- `router/index.ts` — `/:projectName/activity` route removed.
- `config/appComponentsMap.js` — `activity → components/wall/Wall.vue` mapping removed.
- Desktop nav: `components/layout/AppsSection.vue` (sidebar item + `handleNavigateToActivity`), `components/main-menu/MainMenuItems.vue`, `components/main-menu/WindowsMenuItems.vue`.
- Mobile: `MOBILE_TABS` no longer has the Activity tab (now Home · Chats · Tasks · More), the “Activity wall” launcher tile is gone, the `activity` route title is gone.
- `components/mobile/MobileTabBar.vue` — activity route mapping dropped; the tab grid is now sized from `tabs.length` (4 tabs on mobile, still 5 for the company tab bar) instead of a hard-coded `grid-cols-5`.
- `components/mobile/MobileShell.vue` — `'activity'` removed from the tab-root list (so no stale header rules).
- `router/navigate.js` — removed the now dead `isActivityView` getter and `openActivity()` opener, and the stale doc-comment example.

Notes for review:
- `client/src/components/wall/*` (Wall.vue + 11 files) is now unreferenced; I could not delete files with my toolset — delete the folder if you want the code gone as well.
- A previously saved desktop layout that still has an **Activity** panel will render that tab empty once; close it (or reset the layout) — new layouts can’t create it.
- The internal “Activity” panel inside the Kanban view (`KanbanView.vue` → `ChatHistory`) is a task follow-up view, not the Activity wall, so I left it untouched.
